name: Parameter reassignment
description: Flags a function/event parameter assigned a new value anywhere in its own body.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, a function/event parameter assigned a new value anywhere in its own body (`total = 1`, `total += 1`, ...), since reusing the parameter's name for a different value discards what the caller passed in and can confuse a reader expecting it to still reflect the original argument. A member/index assignment built from a parameter (`akRef.Foo = 1`), or a reassignment of an unrelated local variable, is never flagged.
